book.name: 2 KOLINTI
book.title: Kolinti wewenasida luhuwa naba 2 Polokaho je biye

content: We napateya nasahililaki we nebomuye loko monoka yowanumuya loletaibo nenako, yamuya osele-pasele ametune.

Sa-noko adoha lihima soto pekatiye loko sunauka lekaka noudawo nesa maya lemesa mekokote mako suwamidana mupilalo minoko Omaimidana gala le opa okaka amune. Omaimidana omudaloya monokala maya le akutoko lo soto moloko lo nobuniyoko, muki wewenasiya monawate mudataboya wehe loko netiye.

Omailimoya hapa yeimalokaya lubu jekoko neyoko, lameda letiye loko liyoko, lameda liye. Ito eimolakaho lukauya monokamidana lamedala maya le lolowa okaiyoko, Jisesi Kalaestida omudaloya Omaimidana huwepalamo he hada okaiyoko mudaokaka noudawo nenako, lemoya monoka noloko maya lemotemuya lo libamune. Jisesi Kalaestiya lemo We napateyae loko, ito Jisesikumuye loko elekele oluhotipole muki lolo okoko minatune loko muki lo libekaka noune. Sa-onebo nenako, ga lalowa lokaka noudawo maya halukoko lokaka noudawo elekaiyoko latila itabo wewenasitokago halukoko lokaka nobo ilekaka noiye.

Monoka eli hulikaka niabo wewenasidaya maya mikauti uliki we olohalimoya dukanipo le li lokaiyoko nenako, nena nena okoma ga lalomidana lamedala maya dukau lemekadeko Kalaestiya Omaimidana aweyahalalo nebo wemidana luhuwala maya mudai wehe liki mudatae.

Ito aya monokaya meinawa yoweko nebo le-minokaka noudawo wewenalitaya, aya monoka maya lo nobuniyoko lupamoya mika somokidana elewole amiyoko, aya monokamidana elewoleyawaya lemotokati nehekala, Omailokati nenako, monawaya eimotokatigo soto pekaka noiye.
Miluma nesamidana mupilalo minuniyoko, yalimoya ma lilime hulo yolalo malo amiye. Ito lata lowe kuniyoko woko opa amiye.
Ulana nesamidana mupilalo minudawoya, woko ma latila amune.
Yamidana Jisesikaho minoko leko okaka noibo ukalamidana oko lupaloka soto pitiye loko lupalokatiya Jisesida koha heleyoko nebomidana aweyaha oko monekaka noune.

Wewenasiya Jisesidamuye liki lemo owate luwibo nesa liki luwateuya nisi heta heta iki lilimi opa-napa iki helekaka anugu lilimi molikaka niaboya, Jisesi minoko leko ibomidana abuha-wowola maya lupaloka soto pitiye loko lemotoka soto pekaka noiye.
Sa-okaiyoko, lemoya helekaka nesamidana mupilalo maya minudawo ne. Ito edimoya elewole oko minokakamidana epawauya minikaka niae.

Monoka bukuguya luhuwa mako sa-loko nebo ne: Nemokahoya We napadamuya elewole oko elekaka nonako, monokaya lokaka noe. Ito lemokiya makoko aweyaha oko Omaimidana weuna oluholimo lilime lolowa iyoko, We napamuya ele elewole noudanaki monokala lokaka noune.
Sa-udanaki, sa-loko elekaka noune: We napa Jisesida helenebokuti ilime sinaibo welimoya lemokiya asako magoina Jisesikiya helekakakuti lilime sinokoko edimokiya Jisesi nebotoka lilime molakolaiye.

Lemoya muki miluma nesaya edimokumuye loko oko moloko okaka noudawoya Omaimidana nasahilila wasawakilimoya hutili oko nowideko, muki wewenasiya elikiki Omaimidana epoka liki elowa jiki minadeko, Omaimidana luhuwala maya soto pekoko napa oko netiye loko ne. 6 Jen 1:13 3 Sam 116:10
Lemoya yamuya sa-loko elekudanaki ma osele amune. Lupate hukokaka noiboya, muki yupekaya Omaimo weuna oluholotiya lukateya aku le ohatama okaka noiye.
Mikaukaya onawa lasolasiya miluma lasolasi noeludawolimoya alika onowela lalomidana ito edawaki ito elewole okakamidanaya le soto molo lemekadeko, dowa loko minakolune.

Sa-noiyoko, mudakaka noudawo nesaya aha nesa lolo etibo ne. Ito mudamudawo nesalimoya elewole oko minowa minowa oko netibo nenako, yamuya edawaki nesa lolo ilitikaka niabo nesalo nehekala, halukonebo nesalimo soto peletatiye loko yalokaya wenu o-minokaka noune.
